t: For the place you live to be safe
a: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ
p: Rabbi-jʿal hādhā baladan āminan wa-rzuq ahlahu mina-th-thamarāt.
m: My Lord, make this a secure city, and provide its people with fruits.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
